title: Cute Young Siblings Outdoors with Doll, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot of two young children standing outdoors in a garden or yard on a bright sunny day. The older girl on the left wears a collared, puffed-sleeve dress and carries a small shoulder purse while cradling a baby doll in her arm. Beside her stands a young blond boy wearing a belted shorts set with a wide collar. In the background behind the dense evergreen shrubs sits a parked late 1930s or early 1940s pickup truck.
